prices_source: List prices (Anthropic, Z.ai pricing pages, checked 2026-11-17). Models through opencodex: GLM-5.3 Flash on Ammar's Z.ai Coding Plan, Opus 5.5 on the active Claude account. Same policy as phase2-droid-glm-takeover28.json (v2.8); only the backend differs (2026-11-18). Per-call output cap 32k tokens (Droid-era GLM p99 ~32k; 2026-11-18 API runs had 61k-token runaway calls). GLM effort pinned to high: Z.ai's API default is max, Droid's default was high (docs.z.ai concept-param, droid exec --help, 2026-11-18). Builder wall time 1500 -> 3300 s: GLM through opencodex streams 58-59 output tok/s vs 129-141 under Droid (long calls, v4d4/v4d5 vs dv8/dv13/ho2), so the same work needs ~2.2x the time; the 50-command limit is unchanged.
